descriptions.notStarted: Where is this? What's going on? You don't even know who you are.
descriptions.inProgress: #p1202001# seems to be really excited at having met a hero. A hero? Who…you? Judging from what #p1201000# is saying, maybe you really were a hero in your past life. But you have no recollection of it…
descriptions.completed: Since drinking the potion, your HP recovered quite a bit. You still don't know what's going on, but considering how nicely everyone's been treating you, they must have good intentions. You should have no trouble going back to town now...
